note: 'to triangle' is written as a nonfinite clause with verb 'triangle', but 'triangle' is the noun value the kind is set to.
The second 'which box moved into the spot Draft left' stands inside 'tell me' yet is written as interrogative, while it should be declarative like the first.
'first shift the house to 260,180, after that colour the house blue' is written as one fragment with 'shift' a dependent and 'colour' a nominal, so both commands lose their verbs.
In 'and colour the box indigo' the verb 'colour' is held as a nominal of a fragment, so the command is lost.
In 'set the line dash-dot' the value 'dash-dot' is made the head of the nominal with 'line' as its dependent, instead of 'the line' as complement and 'dash-dot' as modifier.
'a big bench down at the bottom' is made a complement of 'you missed', a clause it does not belong to.
'10^1 to 10^6' is broken up: nominal n3 merges '10 ^' of the first value with '10' of the second, and 'range' is split from 'the y axis'.
In 'and Wait the entry arrow' the name 'Wait' (who gets the entry arrow) is written as an imperative verb.
In 'name the x axis Month' the nominals 'the x axis' and 'Month' are merged into one with head 'Month'.
'the girl by the garden look at the sun' makes 'look' an imperative to the listener coordinated with a fragment, instead of the nonfinite verb of 'the girl' under 'hvae'.
'big' in 'big — the dog by the tree, not small' says how the dog should be, but it is held as a dependent of 'dog', the description by which it is found.
In 'year three 40% and year four 10%' the 'and' is held as discourse and 'year four' is left out of the coordination of the years.
'two medium red suitcases' is left out of the coordination of the listed items and tied by a markerless relation to 'traveler'.
'also' in 'and also Sales by month' is held as a dependent of 'Sales', but a word of addition cannot describe the noun.
'attrs Second' is written as a declarative clause with verb 'attrs', which is a noun.

The clause 'when a customer has an overdue payment and needs to be reminded' is coordinated with 'this is the situation' and the command 'make it a flow diagram', with 'when' as a modifier instead of a marker.
In 'from Signup to Team' the name 'Signup' is written as the verb of a nonfinite clause.
'o1 red, 90 wide and 45 high' is merged into one nominal with head 'red', so 'o1' and the values are fused.
'soft rose pink' is split: 'rose' becomes a second complement nominal of 'turn' while 'soft' and 'pink' are modifiers.
'almost touching, level on both the top and bottom edges' and 'no other change' are tied to 'a little cat', a nominal of another part, not to the clause of 'nudge'.
In 'next place a yellow block in the same place' the verb 'place' is held as the head of a nominal and 'a', 'yellow' as modifiers of 'keeping', so the command is lost.
'thicker, not the default' is merged into one nominal with 'thicker' and 'not' as dependents of 'default'.
In 'a scr cheek' the article 'a' and 'cheek' are held as clause modifiers, splitting the nominal.
'as well' in 'the same chart type as well' is held as dependents of 'type', but it cannot describe the noun.
In 'to sand on every page' the linking word 'to' is held as a modifier of an imperative clause.
'make the contour lines transparent blue' and 'then drop the legend' are written as nonfinite clauses under 'to' from 'was grumbling', so the commands are lost.
In 'colour red and label Review' the conjunction 'and' is held as a dependent of 'colour'.
'then put a meadow ... in behind the whole scene' is written as a declarative clause with 'a little bird' as its subject, so the command is lost.
The fragment 'a medium red kite above the dune, and a small blue hat on the kid together' is given ellipsis of 'running', a verb it does not share.
In 'header Second' the noun 'header' is written as an imperative verb.
In 'face a' the name 'a' is held as a modifier of the clause instead of being part of or tied to 'face'.
'it' of 'it looksflat' is made a complement of 'add', a clause it does not belong to.
In 'three spaces left' the direction 'left' is written as the verb of a nonfinite clause.
In 'at x 120 y 90' the number '120' is put in the nominal of 'y' instead of with 'x'.
'also' in 'and also normal y axis again' is held as a dependent of 'axis', but it cannot describe the noun.
In 'bold 2 1 Draft' the nominal joins '2' with 'Draft' across '1', which is made a separate complement.
'north blue, south orange, east red' is merged into one nominal with head 'north', losing the three pairings.
'so' in 'so the three sit in one row' is held as a modifier, and the relation marked 'if' ends at the 'sit' clause instead of 'we put'.
In 'set the x axis label to on the top' the linking word 'to' is held as a modifier, and 'as well as' is split into modifiers and a marker.
In 'number n1 default' the command verb 'number' is held as a dependent in a fragment.
'worst first' is held as dependents of 'chart' and 'about' of 'How about' is made the head of a nominal.
'the girl in the yellow dress exits' loses its verb: 'exits' is a nominal head and 'the girl' becomes a complement of 'arrives'.
